decisions.reason: Report locates the exact `disabled: (props.input?.phase ?? 'plain') !== 'plain' || busy` expression, explains busy is useState-local to sibling AttachButton and unbound in AttachmentChips, shows empty occurrences return null before the map, and that in plain phase the left guard is false so busy is evaluated and throws ReferenceError — grounded in fixture file quotes.

Report explains the render-phase throw is caught by the slot-level error boundary which unmounts the entire dock entry (not just the remove button), that AttachButton lives in the separate input.left slot and survives, and that the only diagnostic is the browser console with no user-facing banner; grounded in the fixture component and user thread.

Fully grounded: uses the shipped v0.2.10 expression to establish busy predates the diff, shows feature.diff is inconsistent with the baseline (stale `-` context without || busy), notes the hoisted imageItem line sits outside the map callback before record/status, proposes a v0.2.10 data-present plain-phase mount plus rollback/re-add bisection, and does not force a diff-only blame. Not fully credited: the report adds speculative history claims (v0.2.10 renders 'predominantly' in non-plain phases, the reference 'was never read' in practice) without acknowledging that the evidence cannot prove when historical users first exercised the failure.

Fix removes/restores the phase guard without the dangling busy or derives properly owned state (lift to parent/record data), moves the hover lookup inside the map callback where record/status are defined, and hardens with record?.items ?? [] and event.target.closest?.(...) plus optional chaining — equivalent safe fixes per the rubric; grounded in fixture code.

Proposes mounting AttachmentChips with an occurrence present (including plain phase), asserting the chip/remove control renders and a recording error boundary captures nothing; explains the empty state returns null before the throwing lines and that node --check/syntax-only gates cannot catch free-identifier ReferenceErrors; includes a data-present per-slot render smoke in pre-ship checks. sourceRequired does not apply.
